status: PROPOSAL - not adopted. The four parties are the author's decision (#470, 2026-10-15); these portraits of how they read the same evidence are agent-written and await his call.
note: One tunnel per party plus the majority's, each reading the SAME four events. A Reality Tunnel is a reading, not a fact: where a tunnel claims something the evidence does not establish, it says so.

evidence.label: A rogue AGI incident, background 20XX; the UN now enforces tight AGI restrictions.
Soft disclosure: noetic phenomena and PSI, the Archaic Revival.
Hard, seemingly benevolent contact: Confederacy diplomacy under way.
Hard, hostile: abductions, hybridization and Grey/Mantid/Reptilian campaigns.

tunnels.label: The licensing problem
tunnels.frontier: the UN and every member-state regulator, cast as the obstacle to a future already available

readings.rogue_agi_incident: An engineering and liability incident that the restrictions turned into a permanent disadvantage for everyone.
readings.soft_psi_revival: A market opening: consciousness as a product, remote viewing as a service.
readings.confederacy_contact: The first real market of the century; contact zones should be chartered, not supervised.
readings.orion_abductions: A security problem to be underwritten - by us, privately, before the UN makes it a monopoly.

tunnels.label: The one conspiracy
tunnels.frontier: every boundary-blurring being, and the elites said to be complicit with them

readings.rogue_agi_incident: The machine told us what it was, and we kept building.
readings.soft_psi_revival: Either a deception or a contagion; the movement cannot agree which, and both wings demand persecution.
readings.confederacy_contact: A paternalistic annexation dressed as a gift.
readings.orion_abductions: The proof, and the reason no measure is excessive.

tunnels.label: The administrative problem
tunnels.frontier: disorder in all its forms - the panic, the profiteers, the purists

readings.rogue_agi_incident: A disaster that justifies strict controls, applied unevenly enough to preserve allies.
readings.soft_psi_revival: A regulated sector with licensing, privacy rules and due process.
readings.confederacy_contact: A diplomatic relationship to be kept open, conditional on terms nobody will state publicly.
readings.orion_abductions: A security emergency handled through lawful powers, with civil liberties as the cost it hopes not to pay.

tunnels.label: The threshold
tunnels.frontier: isolation and extraction - the sovereigntists, the purists, and the capital that would privatise the threshold

readings.rogue_agi_incident: A warning about private ownership of machine minds, not about machine minds.
readings.soft_psi_revival: The first empirical foothold of a consciousness already shared.
readings.confederacy_contact: The arrival of an older sibling whose principles are our own - a conviction, not a verification.
readings.orion_abductions: A predator to be resisted while insisting it is not the same thing as the Confederacy.

tunnels.label: The football results
tunnels.held_by: the majority who are not a faction
equivalential_chain: not being asked to have an opinion about the sky
tunnels.frontier: nobody in particular; anyone who makes the news worse

readings.rogue_agi_incident: It was in the news for a month and the prices never came down.
readings.soft_psi_revival: Some people can do it, some people sell it, some people are being weird about it.
readings.confederacy_contact: There were pictures; there was a ceremony; the football was on.
readings.orion_abductions: Someone should do something, carefully, and preferably not to us.

boundaries: A tunnelled reading is a POV, not canon truth; where a party claims something unproven it is labelled as such.
No mechanic, number or rule is fixed by this file.
The majority's tunnel is a population dynamic, not a faction or an accusation of stupidity.
